headline: Sequential dip; momentum to recover in 2HFY27

highlights: Per (%) 11/-2/51 12M Avg Val (INR M) 14262 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E Mar FY26 FY27E FY28E Net Sales 48.3 64.0 74.7 EBITDA 31.6 44.7 52.4 PAT 24.6 36.6 42.4 Adj.
This was driven by 42% YoY growth in transaction charges and 20% YoY growth in revenue from services to corporates.

For 1HFY27, revenue grew ~50% YoY. ◼ Opex came in at INR4.5b, rising 19% YoY/declining 9% QoQ (in line), with employee costs growing 20% YoY, while regulatory expenses/technology costs/other expenses/clearing house expenses grew 13%/21%/23%/26% YoY.
Operational leverage resulted in a 6% EBITDA beat, which stood at INR9.8b, growing 42% YoY (down 8% QoQ).

Key takeaways from the management commentary ◼ BSE does not intend to revise transaction, colocation, or docket charges at present, unless market participants indicate a need. ◼ 175–190 colocation racks are under construction, with execution timelines to be accelerated depending on demand. ◼ Expiry of existing bank guarantees is yet to play out, making the impact of BG regulations difficult to assess.
